page.overview:
Who is Oscar Morales?

Oscar Morales was one of the InGen mercenaries in Jurassic Park: The Game.

Oscar is one of a number of mercenaries retained by the InGen corporation. Twelve years prior to the events that unfolded in the first movie he was hired, along with many other mercenaries, to "remove" the native people on Isla Nublar after it's purchase by InGen from the Costa Rican government. This was done so that the island could be converted into Jurassic Park without the security or liability concerns of having an existing population.

Oscar killed some of the indigenous people who tried to resist the relocation, an act which Nima views as murder leading her to despise him. However when discussing the matter afterward Oscar seemed to feel remorse for his actions toward the civilian population of Isla Nublar recognizing it as an immoral act on his part. To remind himself of those people who either died for him or were killed by him, Oscar had a sleeve of tattoos inked onto his left arm; the gravestones symbolizing his friends who died for him and the skulls symbolizing the enemies he had killed.

Oscar and his young comrade Billy Yoder, arrive by helicopter to Isla Nublar as part of an operation by InGen to extract remain personnel trapped on the island. After they found the survivors, they had multiple confrontations with the many carnivores that roamed the island. Oscar was already a skilled fighter and brave in the face of peril, as evidenced by engaging in one-to-one combat with a Velociraptor and succeeding in killing it as well as scarring the alpha-female. He also seemed to have good knowledge of the names of the dinosaurs on the island, seen when correcting Billy Yoder from calling a Pteranodon a Pterodactyl.
